cost: With the lexicon stand-in the model is asked about 225 of 290 challenge documents, about 1758 input tokens each (estimated from the size of the payload and the instructions, ~3 characters per token). Latency and actual token counts are NOT measured: there is no network call in this benchmark. The approximate API cost is **not computed**: no price is known for the configured model, and none was invented. Pass `--price-in` / `--price-out` (USD per million tokens) to compute it.
